$comment: AIWorx corporate-brand tokens — a faithful extract of the brand assets, not a description of what the report renders. Theme colors extracted from AIWorx_template.pptx (ppt/theme/theme1.xml, clrScheme 'Custom 6'); logo colors sampled from AIWorx_logo.png. The report's theme (powerbi/cc-otel-report.Report/StaticResources/RegisteredResources/AIWorx.json) consumes most of these verbatim, but deliberately departs on two (specified in #130, agreed #129, shipped #132): Segoe UI / Segoe UI Semibold rather than 'fonts', and logo.wordmark rather than theme.accent1.

charts.$comment: Chart-safe categorical palettes derived from the theme accents (same hues, lightness snapped into the OKLCH band per mode). Raw theme accents FAIL as data colors: accent1 too dark, accent4/accent6 too light + sub-3:1 contrast on white. Re-validated with the dataviz six-checks script 2026-07-26 after #315 darkened the green slot — all checks pass in both modes (worst adjacent CVD deltaE: 10.5 light / 9.8 dark, all contrast >= 3:1; the earlier 19.7/28.9 figures predate the script's current Machado CVD model and no longer reproduce). Slot 5 keeps the lighter amber deliberately: an amber dark enough for the 4.5:1 text floor is equiluminant with slot 6 red and collapses to deltaE 1.0 under deuteranopia, so the semantic `neutral` text token diverges from this slot rather than dragging it down (ADR-0013). Assign slots in this fixed order, never cycled; >6 series folds into 'Other'.

gradient.$comment: The 'Ai' mark runs teal -> blue -> purple.
